text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Vodka. Scarlet. Just you wait.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: The Oka Sho is going to Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"The Oka Sho is going to Aston
Machan"...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I see. Maybe I underestimated
Machan.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There's no denying her speed or power,
and her
raw talent is evident even
among racers in her
year.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But I never saw her as a rival. Maybe it's
because I
assumed she had no interest in
me...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I never thought she'd consider
competing with me
for anything.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
All right, Machan. I'll accept your
challenge!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Raaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff! This is tough...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
But it's not enough! It's nowhere near
enough!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
This is finally getting fun. I'm gonna
snatch that
lead, leave everyone else in
the dust, and win by
a mile!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: One more lap! Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's challenge made quite a

wave—one that crashed hardest against
her two
rivals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that she's thrown down the
gauntlet, I have
to be at my best for her.
I psych myself up and
head to our
training session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. Spring and I don't really get
along, that's
all. I can still train.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite understand what she
means, but I do
know it's best to nip
these things in the bud. Just
to be safe, I
take her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it's not a cold. And I don't think
it's hay
fever either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's just as she said—she doesn't seem to
be
suffering from anything in particular.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I told you... it's just that spring and...

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
It might be exhaustion. Let's let her rest
a while
before we send her home.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Although she seems healthy, I
recommend that
she refrain from training
today. She can resume
tomorrow, but
please keep an eye on her for the
time
being.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We come away unsure of what's got her
under the
weather...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And her condition fails to improve for
several
days.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She did say she doesn't really get along
with
spring, so she must have some idea
about what's
going on...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to pick her mind about it a little
more.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I just get like this in the spring.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I get sleepy and distracted, and just
generally
unwell.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I've had all kinds of examinations at my
mom's
hospital, and tried both
medication and herbal
remedies, but
we've never figured it out.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
So, basically, spring and I just don't get
along.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's mother is a doctor. That
must
mean the true cause of her
condition really is
unclear.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It's okay. I'll feel better in summer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but yes. I guess I can't really run in
the Oka
Sho like this...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: All right, I might have something for this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she suddenly leaves my
office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She comes back carrying a lunch box.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm holding a gathering to help improve
my
relationship with spring.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I packed some springy things that
caught my
eye—scouring rushes, a
canola flower, and some
mochi balls.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
First, I'll line them up... and then I'll
shower them
with praise!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have no idea whether this will actually
resolve
the issue, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In fact, it's possible that her current
malaise is
down to stress about the
upcoming Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to go along with her idea in the
hope
that it will give her some peace of
mind.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Your color and shape are wonderful. You
know,
when I think of spring flowers,
you're the first one
that comes to mind,
Canola Dazzly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wouldn't you say so, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And as for you—you look lovely and you
taste
delicious. You're even a pleasure
to knead.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Just what I'd expect from squidgy little

Three-Colors.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then we've got you, the rushes. You
look so
lovely all lined up on the
riverbank.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
But I expected nothing less from you,

brushy-rushy-rushes.
Don't they look
nice, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spring-themed get-together
continues in that
vein until the sun sets...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well, I suppose that's that. I feel
like
spring and I are already much closer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I should be okay tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Did you hear the ocean just now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks confident that she heard it...
but I'm
pretty sure I didn't hear any
ocean sounds.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume have very good hearing.
Maybe she
heard something my ears
couldn't pick up.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder. Could it have been a TV?
But...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, you're probably right. That must be
it.
